data.title: 小岭幸 · 泳道起点的一丝不苟
data.description: 清早的室内恒温泳池还泛着安静的水汽，小岭幸双手抱紧一块天蓝色浮板立在泳道起跳台边，赤脚踩在防滑瓷砖上认真听取划水要领。深蓝竞技死库水一丝不苟地贴合身形，她点头记下每一个细节，神情就像准备执行重要任务。
data.location: 水波澄净的美浜室内恒温泳池畔
data.action: 赤脚站于泳道边双手抱紧浮板，认真倾听点头
data.lighting: 泳池高窗透入的清透天光与湛蓝池水漫反射
data.camera: 全身略侧，泳道分界线拉出清晰纵深
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot on the pale poolside tiles beside a lane marker, Sachi Komine hugs a light-blue kickboard squarely against her chest while listening closely to instructions. Bright skylight from the high windows sparkles across the calm indoor pool behind her navy school swimsuit.
data.animaCaption: Standing barefoot by the indoor pool lane, she hugs a blue kickboard neatly against her chest.
